note: CP-1 prices of the Fish Row market. base_reales_per_kg is the price of 1 kg of FRESH fish before the market spread and before the market remembers your sales (core/market.gd). Owner B4; provisional. Every number is explained in docs/CP1_CAPITAL_PORT.md.

spc_sardine.name: Sardine
spc_sardine.note: Cheap and plentiful: the first-trip fish. B4 prices fresh fish at 2/kg on average; a sardine is the bottom of that range.

spc_parrotfish.name: Parrotfish
spc_parrotfish.note: A reef fish: only the Kelp Reef gives it.

spc_red_snapper.name: Red Snapper
spc_red_snapper.note: Prized at table; reef and deep water.

spc_yellowfin_tuna.name: Yellowfin Tuna
spc_yellowfin_tuna.note: The best fish of the prologue; only the far Blue Drop holds it.
